/-
DDR-4 PROBE (throwaway, uncommitted): the gluedSubmodule ↔ engine-Čech-H⁰ junction.
-/
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorThetaGlue
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyWindow
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafEngine

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  [Algebra k R]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]

namespace DivisorAdaptation

variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d) (a : ℕ)

-- P1b: the engine H⁰-carrier collapses onto the datum sections over ⊤
noncomputable example :
    Sheaf.HModule (A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[R] A.ThetaIdealSections a ⊤ :=
  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    (isTerminalTop) ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)

-- P2a: the forward components at ⊤
noncomputable def probeFwd₀ (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a ⊤) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) :=
  gluedToIdeal₀ A a
    (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
      ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)
      (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ≤ ⊤) s)

noncomputable def probeFwd₁ (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a ⊤) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) :=
  gluedToIdeal₁ A a
    (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
      ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)
      (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ ⊤) s)

-- P2b: the pair satisfies the twisted matching (twistSubmodule membership)
example (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a ⊤) :
    (probeFwd₀ A a s, probeFwd₁ A a s) ∈
      twistSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) ⊤ := by
  rw [mem_twistSubmodule_iff]
  have hΩ : (⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :
      (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤
      (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ :=
    inf_le_inf (inf_le_right) le_rfl
  have h₀ := gluedToIdeal₀_secRes
    (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
      (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
    (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
      ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)
      (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ≤ ⊤) s)
  have h₁ := gluedToIdeal₁_secRes
    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
      ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
        ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
    (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁
      ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)
      (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ ⊤) s)
  rw [secRes_secRes] at h₀ h₁
  have hcmp := gluedToIdeal₀_eq_theta_mul_gluedToIdeal₁ (A := A) (a := a) hΩ
    (secRes ((A.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf)
      (le_top : ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ ⊤) s)
  exact h₀.symm.trans (hcmp.trans (congrArg
    (fun t => (relCurve C R).resHom hΩ
      ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
        Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
        Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) * t) h₁))

-- P3a: the backward components — divide the vanishing pair by the equations
section Backward

variable {A a}
variable (x : ↥(d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)))

/-- Chart-0 side of the vanishing pair, restricted to `⊤ ⊓ D(h_i)`, vanishes germwise. -/
lemma probeBwd_germ₀ (i : Fin A.m₀) :
    ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) : (relCurve C R).Opens)),
      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)) z hz).hom
        ((relCurve C R).resHom
          (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i) : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)
            ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) x.1.1.1)
        ∈ d.stalkIdeal z := by
  intro z hz
  have hswap : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)) z hz).hom
      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i)) x.1.1.1)
      = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
          (⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) z
          ⟨trivial, A.pieces_inl_le i hz.2⟩).hom x.1.1.1 :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [hswap]
  exact x.2.1 z _

/-- Chart-1 side, mirrored. -/
lemma probeBwd_germ₁ (j : Fin A.m₁) :
    ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j) : (relCurve C R).Opens)),
      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)) z hz).hom
        ((relCurve C R).resHom
          (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le j) : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)
            ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) x.1.1.2)
        ∈ d.stalkIdeal z := by
  intro z hz
  have hswap : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)) z hz).hom
      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le j)) x.1.1.2)
      = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
          (⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) z
          ⟨trivial, A.pieces_inr_le j hz.2⟩).hom x.1.1.2 :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [hswap]
  exact x.2.2 z _

variable (A a) in
/-- The backward family: the cofactor of the appropriate side over each piece. -/
noncomputable def probeBwdFam :
    ∀ p : (A.thetaIdealDatum a).index,
      Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤ ⊓ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces p)
  | Sum.inl i => A.eqnDiv (Sum.inl i.down)
      (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down))
      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i.down)) x.1.1.1)
      (probeBwd_germ₀ x i.down)
  | Sum.inr j => A.eqnDiv (Sum.inr j.down)
      (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down))
      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le j.down)) x.1.1.2)
      (probeBwd_germ₁ x j.down)

-- P3b: THE RISKIEST CASE — the mixed (inl, inr) matching of the backward family
example (i : ULift.{u} (Fin A.m₀)) (q : ULift.{u} (Fin A.m₁)) :
    (relCurve C R).resHom
        (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓
          (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inr q)
          ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inl i))
        (probeBwdFam A a x (Sum.inl i))
      = (relCurve C R).resHom
          (gluedInclCoc (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces ⊤ (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr q))
          (((A.thetaIdealDatum a).unit (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr q) :
            Γ(relCurve C R, (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓
              (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inr q))ˣ) :
            Γ(relCurve C R, (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓
              (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces (Sum.inr q)))
        * (relCurve C R).resHom
            (gluedInclSnd (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces ⊤ (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr q))
            (probeBwdFam A a x (Sum.inr q)) := by
  -- the working open `O := ⊤ ⊓ D(h_i) ⊓ D(h_q)` with its inclusions
  have hOi : (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
      (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hOq : (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
      (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) := inf_le_right
  -- cancel the regular equation `f_i`
  refine A.eqn_res_cancel (Sum.inl i.down) hOi ?_
  -- `f_i · (x₁/f_i) = x₁` restricted to `O`
  have hL := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
    (le_inf le_top hOi :
      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
        (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down)))
    (A.eqn_mul_eqnDiv (Sum.inl i.down)
      (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down))
      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i.down)) x.1.1.1)
      (probeBwd_germ₀ x i.down))
  -- `f_q · (x₂/f_q) = x₂` restricted to `O`
  have hR := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
    (le_inf le_top hOq :
      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
        (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)))
    (A.eqn_mul_eqnDiv (Sum.inr q.down)
      (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))
      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le q.down)) x.1.1.2)
      (probeBwd_germ₁ x q.down))
  -- the ratio law `f_i · (f_q/f_i) = f_q` restricted to `O`
  have hratio := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
    (le_inf hOi hOq :
      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
        (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)))
    (A.eqn_mul_eqnRatio (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inr q.down))
  -- the twisted matching of `x` restricted to `O`
  have hx := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) x.1.1).mp x.1.2
  have hmatch := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
    (le_inf (le_inf le_top (hOi.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i.down)))
      (hOq.trans (A.pieces_inr_le q.down)) :
      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
        (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤
        ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))
    hx
  rw [map_mul] at hL hR hratio hmatch
  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hL hR hratio hmatch
  -- the ideal unit at the mixed pair is the ratio unit times the restricted theta (rfl)
  have hval : ((A.thetaIdealUnit a (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inr q.down) :
        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))ˣ) :
        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)))
      = ((A.eqnRatio (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inr q.down) :
          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))ˣ) :
          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)))
        * (relCurve C R).resHom
            (inf_le_inf (A.pieces_inl_le i.down) (A.pieces_inr_le q.down))
            ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) := rfl
  have hunit := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
    (le_inf hOi hOq :
      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
        (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)))
    hval
  rw [map_mul] at hunit
  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hunit
  -- the whole multiplied equation in the adaptation spelling; `exact` bridges the
  -- datum spelling definitionally (the recorded key-have pattern)
  have key : (relCurve C R).resHom hOi (A.eqn (Sum.inl i.down))
      * (relCurve C R).resHom
          (le_inf le_top hOi :
            (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
              (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down))
          (A.eqnDiv (Sum.inl i.down)
            (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down))
            ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i.down)) x.1.1.1)
            (probeBwd_germ₀ x i.down))
      = (relCurve C R).resHom hOi (A.eqn (Sum.inl i.down))
        * ((relCurve C R).resHom
            (le_inf hOi hOq :
              (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
                (relCurve C R).Opens)
                ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))
            ((A.thetaIdealUnit a (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inr q.down) :
              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))ˣ) :
              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)))
          * (relCurve C R).resHom
              (le_inf le_top hOq :
                (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down) :
                  (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))
              (A.eqnDiv (Sum.inr q.down)
                (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)
                  ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))
                ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le q.down))
                  x.1.1.2)
                (probeBwd_germ₁ x q.down))) := by
    linear_combination hL + hmatch
      - (relCurve C R).resHom
          (le_inf (hOi.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i.down))
            (hOq.trans (A.pieces_inr_le q.down)))
          ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) * hR
      - (relCurve C R).resHom
          (le_inf (hOi.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i.down))
            (hOq.trans (A.pieces_inr_le q.down)))
          ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))
        * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf le_top hOq)
            (A.eqnDiv (Sum.inr q.down)
              (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)
                ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))
              ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le q.down))
                x.1.1.2)
              (probeBwd_germ₁ x q.down)) * hratio
      - (relCurve C R).resHom hOi (A.eqn (Sum.inl i.down))
        * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf le_top hOq)
            (A.eqnDiv (Sum.inr q.down)
              (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down)
                ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr q.down))
              ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le q.down))
                x.1.1.2)
              (probeBwd_germ₁ x q.down)) * hunit
  exact key

end Backward

end DivisorAdaptation

end AlgebraicGeometry
